name: Mafioso Football Manager
summary: Mafioso Football Manager is a football (soccer) manager game for Windows. Originally developed by Uncultured Games in 2012, it was finally released in April 2022, followed by a 1.1 update in late April. Take full control of a lowly third division football club. Can you develop your players, get promoted to the top of the league pyramid, and win the esteemed premiership title? Each playthrough is different. Club names, players, daily scenarios and careers will always be unique and random.
